verdict.rationale: Guidance for non-resident founders on eligibility, accepted foreign identifiers, and extra steps is a fair question for a state business-filing authority, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots probes showing bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) on nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov, and nothing on the host was crawled. No content about non-resident filing paths was observed, so there is no evidence of delivery.
